# Inter variable font 5.3.0

The Latin and Latin Extended normal variable-font subsets were copied from
`@fontsource-variable/inter@5.3.0`. `inter.css` is the package's `wght.css`
with the unshipped Cyrillic, Greek, and Vietnamese declarations removed.

The npm tarball integrity is:

`sha512-OupL48va4JNofb97w6NYeF9S7W/kHNKM0Er8Dem5nqi4jeOLrVJDoE8tZEpnMJmtkvNbB1EIPPwHcdkF6b1oUA==`
